scenes.narration: Create a Limiter keyed by client IP, attach it to the app, and register the 429 handler.

scenes.visual: Code window, lines reveal, limiter lines highlighted

on_screen.code:
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from slowapi import (Limiter,
    _rate_limit_exceeded_handler)
from slowapi.util import get_remote_address
from slowapi.errors import RateLimitExceeded

limiter = Limiter(
    key_func=get_remote_address)
app = FastAPI()
app.state.limiter = limiter
app.add_exception_handler(
    RateLimitExceeded,
    _rate_limit_exceeded_handler)

scenes.narration: Then decorate the route. Five requests per minute. Don't forget the request parameter.
scenes.subtitle: Then decorate the route. Five requests per minute. Don't forget the request parameter.
